# ADR-040 — Daily/weekly reviews are durable `reviews` rows, unique `(kind, period_start)`; last-review timestamps derived

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

Daily/weekly reviews are durable first-class artifacts in a `reviews` table — unique `(kind, period_start)` with kind `daily\|weekly`, checklist state in `content` jsonb, optional `summary`, completed via explicit completion. "Last review" timestamps are **derived** from completed rows (`max(completed_at)` per kind), not duplicated into columns. No elaborate journaling system (user-approved 2026-08-21)
